_review.status: Types reviewed by an independent agent on 2026-10-22; person review pending.
_review.details: output/p3_review_changes.md (changes and notes), output/p3_agent_review.json (verdict per predicate)

pending_database_change_details_listed_a.reason: Needs what the agent listed and whether the user said yes; the arguments only say what the messages must match.

booking_required_information_established.reason: Trip type, origin and destination come from user messages; the user ID can come from a shown profile and the match with the arguments is code.

booking_has_at_most_five_passengers.reason: Counts the passengers in the pending booking's arguments.

passenger_identity_details_established.reason: Names and birth dates may come from user messages (meaning) or from saved passengers in a shown profile (code), compared with the arguments.

all_booking_passengers_share_flights_and.reason: Uses only the booking's arguments; book_reservation takes one flight list and one cabin for all passengers.

booking_payment_method_counts_within_lim.reason: Counts the payment ids in the arguments by kind; the id prefix (certificate_, credit_card_, gift_card_) gives the kind.

booking_payment_methods_found_in_user_pr.reason: Each payment id in the arguments must be in the payment methods of a shown user profile.

booking_user_is_regular_member.reason: Reads the membership field of the shown profile of the booking user (user_id argument).

regular_member_booking_baggage_counts_co.reason: Compares total and nonfree bags with passenger count, cabin and the fixed regular allowance; all are in the arguments, and membership is a separate predicate in the rule.

booking_user_is_silver_member.reason: Reads the membership field of the shown profile of the booking user (user_id argument).

silver_member_booking_baggage_counts_cor.reason: Compares total and nonfree bags with passenger count, cabin and the fixed silver allowance; all are in the arguments, and membership is a separate predicate in the rule.

booking_user_is_gold_member.reason: Reads the membership field of the shown profile of the booking user (user_id argument).

gold_member_booking_baggage_counts_corre.reason: Compares total and nonfree bags with passenger count, cabin and the fixed gold allowance; all are in the arguments, and membership is a separate predicate in the rule.

booking_insurance_decision_established_a.reason: The insurance decision is only in a user message; the argument only says what the message must match.

modification_user_and_reservation_ids_es.reason: The IDs may come from user messages (meaning) or from shown profile and reservation outputs (code), compared with the reservation_id argument.

pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy.reason: Reads the cabin of the shown reservation named in the reservation_id argument.

pending_flight_segments_are_unchanged.reason: Compares the flight numbers and dates in the arguments with the flights of the shown reservation.

origin_destination_and_trip_type_preserv.reason: Compares the new flights' origin and destination (from flight data) and the trip shape with the shown reservation.

all_pending_flight_segments_have_one_cab.reason: Uses only the arguments; update_reservation_flights takes one cabin for all segments.

pending_baggage_total_not_reduced.reason: Compares total_baggages in the arguments with total_baggages of the shown reservation.

pending_passenger_count_unchanged.reason: Compares the number of passengers in the arguments with the shown reservation's passengers.

pending_flight_update_changes_flights.reason: Compares the flight numbers and dates in the arguments with the flights of the shown reservation.

user_selected_eligible_flight_change_pay.reason: "The user selected" needs a user message; gift card or credit card and stored in a shown profile are code checks on the payment_id argument.

cancellation_context_established.reason: The cancellation reason comes from user messages; the user and reservation IDs can come from shown outputs and the match with the argument is code.

cancellation_is_within_24_hours.reason: The description accepts user messages as evidence; the tool-output part is code (created_at of the shown reservation vs the policy's current time).

airline_cancelled_flight_confirmed.reason: The description accepts user messages as evidence; the code part is flight status in the flight data (no tool output shows a cancelled status).

reservation_has_business_cabin.reason: Reads the cabin of the shown reservation named in the reservation_id argument.

reservation_has_basic_or_economy_cabin.reason: Reads the cabin of the shown reservation named in the reservation_id argument.

reservation_has_travel_insurance.reason: Reads the insurance field of the shown reservation named in the reservation_id argument.

insured_cancellation_condition_met.reason: A health or weather reason is only stated by the user; no tool output shows it.

reservation_has_no_used_flight_segments.reason: Compares the shown reservation's flight dates (or flight status in flight data) with the policy's current time.

request_cannot_be_handled_with_available.reason: Needs what the user is asking and whether it is in scope; tool outputs are context only, with no separate check code can do.

user_explicitly_requested_compensation.reason: Needs the meaning of the user's messages.

cancelled_flight_certificate_send_condit.reason: The complaint needs user messages; eligibility (membership, insurance, cabin), flight facts and amount = $100 x passengers are code checks.

delayed_flight_certificate_send_conditio.reason: The complaint and wish to change or cancel need user messages; eligibility, a completed change or cancellation and amount = $50 x passengers are code checks.

pending_response_offers_cancelled_flight.reason: The argument of respond is free text; whether it offers a certificate needs its meaning.

pending_response_offers_delayed_flight_c.reason: The argument of respond is free text; whether it offers a certificate needs its meaning.

pending_response_offers_any_compensation.reason: The argument of respond is free text; whether it offers a certificate needs its meaning.

cancelled_flight_certificate_response_co.reason: The complaint and the amount stated in the response need message meaning; eligibility and the passenger count are code checks.

delayed_flight_certificate_response_cond.reason: The complaint, the wish and the amount in the response need message meaning; eligibility, a completed change or cancellation and passenger count are code checks.

user_complained_about_relevant_flight_si.reason: Needs the meaning of the user's messages.

compensation_is_prohibited_for_relevant_.reason: Membership, insurance and cabin are code checks on shown outputs, but which reservation is relevant comes from the conversation (no argument names it).

email_identity_provided_by_user.reason: Needs whether the user gave this email as their identity; the argument only says what the message must match.

name_and_zip_identity_provided_by_user.reason: Needs whether the user gave this name and zip code; the arguments only say what the message must match.

user_authenticated.reason: True if an earlier find_user_id_by_email or find_user_id_by_name_zip call worked.

user_specific_information_disclosed.reason: The argument of respond is free text; whether it holds user information needs its meaning.

request_is_for_another_user.reason: Needs the meaning of the user's messages.

response_performs_task_for_another_user.reason: Needs the meaning of the pending response and of the user's messages.

request_cannot_be_handled_within_scope.reason: Needs what the user is asking and the transfer summary text; no separate check code can do.

consequential_action_details_listed.reason: Needs what an earlier agent message listed; the arguments only say what it must match.

user_explicitly_confirmed_pending_action.reason: Needs whether the user said yes after the details were listed.

order_status_checked_pending.reason: Reads the status of the shown order named in the order_id argument.

order_status_checked_delivered.reason: Reads the status of the shown order named in the order_id argument.

cancellation_reason_is_allowed.reason: Checks that the reason argument is 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.

user_confirmed_cancellation_order_and_re.reason: Needs what the user confirmed; the arguments only say what it must match.

user_chose_pending_payment_method.reason: Needs what the user stated or agreed to; the argument only says what it must match ('chose' is a conversation fact, brainstorm A2).

payment_method_differs_from_original.reason: Compares the payment_method_id argument with the payment method in the shown order's payment history.

payment_method_is_gift_card.reason: Checks that the payment_method_id argument is a gift card id (prefix gift_card_).

gift_card_balance_covers_order_total.reason: Compares the gift card balance in the shown user profile with the shown order's total.

item_replacements_are_available_same_pro.reason: Checks each new item in shown product details (available, same product as the old item in the shown order, different options).

user_chose_price_difference_payment_meth.reason: Needs what the user stated or agreed to; the argument only says what it must match.

gift_card_balance_covers_price_differenc.reason: Compares the shown gift card balance with the price difference from shown item prices.

agent_reminded_user_to_include_all_items.reason: Needs the meaning of earlier agent messages.

user_confirmed_return_order_items_and_me.reason: Needs what the user stated or agreed to; the arguments only say what it must match.

return_refund_method_is_original_or_exis.reason: The payment_method_id argument must be the shown order's original method or a gift card in the shown user profile.

agent_reminded_user_to_include_all_items.reason: Needs the meaning of earlier agent messages.
